name: chihairou-yungu-local
description: chihairou's Yungu (local): the desktop shell around the standalone Next server.

scripts.build:wifi-helper: mkdir -p build/bin && swiftc -O native/wifi-ssid.swift -o build/bin/wifi-ssid -framework CoreWLAN -framework CoreLocation -Xlinker -sectcreate -Xlinker __TEXT -Xlinker __info_plist -Xlinker native/wifi-ssid-Info.plist
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build:server && npm run build && npm run build:wifi-helper && electron-builder --mac --arm64
scripts.dist:linux-dir: npm run build:server && npm run build && electron-builder --linux dir
